newsitem.title: TURKEY: Rebel Kurds kill four soldiers in eastern Turkey.
newsitem.headline: Rebel Kurds kill four soldiers in eastern Turkey.

text.p: Rebel Kurds killed four Turkish soldiers in clashes in the remote eastern province of Tunceli in the early hours of Monday, security officials said.

Two soldiers were killed in an ambush by around 50 Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) rebels near Yukari Doluca village. Another two soldiers were killed in a separate attack in the Ovacik district, the officials said.
The clashes came as thousands of Turkish troops, backed by air power, continued a cross-border operation into northern Iraq against PKK bases used for raids into southeast Turkey.
More than 24,000 people have died in the 12-year struggle between Turkish security forces and the PKK, who are fighting for independence or autonomy in mainly Kurdish southeast Turkey.
